chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Habib al-Sijistani who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying:

Indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, when He extracted the offspring of Adam (peace be upon him) from his back in order to take the covenant upon them regarding His Lordship and prophethood for every prophet, the first one for whom He took the covenant upon them — regarding his prophethood — was Muhammad ibn Abdullah (may God's blessings be upon him and his family).

Then Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said to Adam: 'Look! What do you see?' He said: So Adam (peace be upon him) looked at his offspring, and they were tiny particles that had filled the sky. Adam (peace be upon him) said: 'O Lord! How abundant are my offspring! And for what purpose did You create them? So what do You want from them by taking the covenant upon them?' Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: 'That they worship Me, not associating anything with Me, and believe in My messengers and follow them.'

Adam (peace be upon him) said: 'O Lord! Why do I see some of the particles greater than others, some of them have much light, some of them have little light, and some of them have no light?' So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: 'Thus have I created them, in order to test them in all their states.' Adam (peace be upon him) said: 'O Lord! Will You permit me to speak?' Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: 'Speak, for your spirit is from My Spirit, but your nature is contrary to My Being.' Adam said: 'O Lord! If only You had created them upon one likeness, one measure, one nature, one constitution, one colour, one lifespan, and equal sustenance — then some of them would not oppress others, and there would be no envy, hatred, or disagreement among them regarding anything.'

Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: 'O Adam! By My Spirit you spoke, but by the weakness of your nature you ventured into what you have no knowledge of. I am the Creator, the All-Knowing. By My knowledge I have differentiated in their creation, and by My will My command runs among them, and to My management and My ordainment they are coming. There is no alteration in My creation. Indeed, I created the jinn and mankind only that they worship Me. And I created Paradise for those among them who obey Me, worship Me, and follow My messengers — and I do not retract. And I created the Fire for those who disbelieve in Me, disobey Me, and do not follow My messengers — and I do not retract. And I created you and your offspring not out of any need I have for you or them. Rather, I created you and created them to test you and test them — which of you excels in deed in the abode of the world, during your lifetime and before your death. For that reason I created this world and the next, life and death, obedience and disobedience, Paradise and the Fire.'

And likewise I intended in My ordainment and My management, and with My penetrating knowledge among them I differentiated between their forms, their bodies, their colours, their lifespans, their sustenance, their obedience and their disobedience. So I made among them the wretched and the fortunate, the seeing and the blind, the short and the tall, the beautiful and the ugly, the knowledgeable and the ignorant, the rich and the poor, the obedient and the disobedient, the healthy and the sick, and those with disabilities and those with no affliction. So the healthy looks at the one with the affliction and praises Me for his own well-being. And the one with the affliction looks at the healthy and supplicates to Me and asks Me to grant him well-being, and is patient in My trial, so I reward him generously from My gifts. And the rich looks at the poor and praises Me and thanks Me. And the poor looks at the rich and supplicates to Me and asks Me. And the believer looks at the disbeliever and praises Me for guiding him.

For that reason I created them — to test them in ease and adversity, in what I grant them well-being and in what I afflict them, in what I give them and in what I withhold from them. And I am Allah, the King, the All-Powerful. It is Mine to execute all that I have ordained according to what I have managed. And it is Mine to change whatever I will of that to whatever I will, and to bring forward what I had delayed, and to delay what I had brought forward. And I am Allah, the Doer of whatever I will. I am not questioned about what I do, and I shall question My creation about what they do.'

key_terms.الابتلاء: Trial, testing; divine test through worldly circumstances
key_terms.الذر: Tiny particles, atoms; the primordial form of all human souls
key_terms.الذرية: Offspring, descendants; here the pre-worldly particles extracted from Adam's back
key_terms.الكينونة: Divine Being, existence; refers to God's essential nature
key_terms.الميثاق: The primordial covenant, the Covenant of Alast (referring to Quran 7:172)

ai.seo_question: What is the hadith about the covenant of Alast and Adam's offspring as particles of light in Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) narrates a profound cosmological account of the primordial covenant (mithaq), in which God extracted all of Adam's offspring as particles of light from his back, took their covenant acknowledging His Lordship and the prophethood of all prophets — beginning with Muhammad (SAWW) — and revealed to Adam the divine wisdom behind human diversity. When Adam questioned why God created humans with different qualities of light, lifespans, and provisions, God replied that He tests humanity through this very diversity: the healthy praise Him when they see the afflicted, the afflicted turn to Him in prayer, the rich thank Him when they see the poor, and the believer thanks Him for guidance. This hadith directly addresses 7:172 (the Day of Alast), the divine purpose in creation (51:56), and divine sovereignty (21:23), grounding the Shia theology of divine justice and free will within the framework of pre-eternal covenant.
word_analysis: and it is Mine/belongs to Me

‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic.

When He<sup>azwj</sup> Extracted the offspring of Adam<sup>as</sup> from his<sup>as</sup> back in order to Take the Covenant with the Lordship for Himself<sup>azwj</sup>, and with the Prophet-hood for every Prohet<sup>as</sup>, so the first one He<sup>azwj</sup> Took the Covenant for Himself<sup>azwj</sup> upon him with his<sup>saww</sup> Prophet-hood was Muhammad Bin Abdullah<sup>saww</sup>.
Then Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Said to Adam<sup>as</sup>: “Look!

What do you<sup>as</sup> see?” He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So Adam<sup>as</sup> looked at his<sup>as</sup> children, and they were particles which had filled up the sky. Adam<sup>as</sup> said: ‘O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! How abundant are my<sup>as</sup> children and for what matter have You<sup>azwj</sup> Created them? So what do You<sup>azwj</sup> Want from them by Taking the Covenant upon them?’ Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Said: “For them to be worshipping Me<sup>azwj</sup> not associating anything with Me<sup>azwj</sup>, and believing in My<sup>azwj</sup> Rasools<sup>as</sup> and following them<sup>as</sup>”.
Adam<sup>as</sup> said: ‘O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>!

So what is the matter I<sup>as</sup> see some of the particles to be greater than the others, and some of them have a lot of light for them, and some of them are of little light, and some of them have no light for them?’ So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Said: “Like that is how I<sup>azwj</sup> Created them in order to Try them in all their states”.
Adam<sup>as</sup> said: ‘O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! So, could You<sup>azwj</sup> Permit me<sup>as</sup> regarding the speech, so I<sup>as</sup> can speak (to them)?’ Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Said: “Speak, for your<sup>as</sup> spirit is from My<sup>azwj</sup> Spirit, but your<sup>azwj</sup> nature is different from My<sup>azwj</sup> Being”. Adam<sup>as</sup> said: ‘O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! If only You<sup>azwj</sup> had Created them upon one likeness, and of one measurement, and of one clay, and of one constitution, and of one colour, and of one age, and with the equal sustenance, some of them would not rebel against the others, and there would neither happen to be between them any envy, or hatred, or differing with regards to anything from the things’.
Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Said: “O Adam<sup>as</sup>!

By My<sup>azwj</sup> Spirit you<sup>as</sup> speak, and by the weakness is in your<sup>as</sup> nature you<sup>as</sup> made the effort on what there is no knowledge for you<sup>as</sup> in it, and I<sup>azwj</sup> am the Creator, the Knowledgeable. With My<sup>azwj</sup> Knowledge I<sup>azwj</sup> Caused the difference in their Creation, and by My<sup>azwj</sup> Desire do I<sup>azwj</sup> Ordain My<sup>azwj</sup> Command among them, and to My<sup>azwj</sup> Management and My<sup>azwj</sup> Ordainment are they coming into being, there being no alteration in My<sup>azwj</sup> Creation.
But rather, I<sup>azwj</sup> Created the Jinn and the human beings for them to be worshipping Me<sup>azwj</sup>, and I<sup>azwj</sup> Created the Paradise for the one who obeys Me<sup>azwj</sup> and worships Me<sup>azwj</sup> from them, and follows My<sup>azwj</sup> Rasools<sup>as</sup>, and I<sup>azwj</sup> do not Retract; and I<sup>azwj</sup> Created the Fire for the one who disbelieve in Me<sup>azwj</sup>, and disobeys Me<sup>azwj</sup>, and does not follow My<sup>azwj</sup> Rasools<sup>as</sup>, and I<sup>azwj</sup> do not Retract.
And I<sup>azwj</sup> Created you<sup>as</sup> and your<sup>as</sup> offspring from without a need of Mine to you<sup>as</sup> and to them, and rather I<sup>azwj</sup> Created you<sup>as</sup> and Created them in order to Test you<sup>as</sup> and Test them, which ones of you is best of deeds in the house of the world during your lifetime and before your deaths. Thus, for that I<sup>azwj</sup> Created the world and the Hereafter, and the life and the death, and the obedience and the disobedience, and the Paradise and the Fire.

And like that, I<sup>azwj</sup> Intended in My<sup>azwj</sup> Ordainment and My<sup>azwj</sup> Management, and with My<sup>azwj</sup> Knowledge, the Implementation among them of the difference between their chests (consciences), and their bodies, and their colours, and their ages, and their sustenance, and their obedience, and their disobedience. So I<sup>azwj</sup> Made from them, the miserable, and the fortunate, and the seeing and the blind, and the short and the long, and the beautiful and the ugly, and the knowledgeable and the ignorant, and the rich and the poor, and the obedient and the disobedient, and the healthy and the sick, and the one with disabilities and the one with no handicap with him.
So the healthy would look at the one with the disability and he would Praise Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>; and the one with the disability would look at the healthy and he would supplicate to Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> and ask Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> for his good health and be patient upon My<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Affliction, so I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> would Grant him a lot of My<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Grants. And the rich would look at the poor and he would Praise Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> and thank Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, and the poor would look at the rich and would suplicate to me and ask Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>. And the Believer would look at the disbeliever and he would Praise Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> upon what I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Guided him.

Thus, it is for that I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Created them in order to Test them during the ease and adversity, and regarding what I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Grant them good health and regarding what I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Test them, and regarding what I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Give them and regarding what I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Prevent them from; and I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> am Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, the King, the Powerful, and for Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> is that I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Implement the entirety of what I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Ordain, and for Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> is that I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Change from that whatever I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> so Desire to whatever I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> so Desire, and I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Bring forward from that whatever I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> had Delayed, and Delay what I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> had Brought forward, and I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> am Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>. I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Do whatever I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Want. I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> will not be questioned about what I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Do, and I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> will be Questioning My<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> creatures about what they are doing”’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from Hisham ibn Salim from Habib al-Sajistani who has said the following:

‘There was a time when Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious, took the descendents of Adam from his back to establish a covenant with them to testify that He is their Lord and to believe in the prophethood of all the prophets. The first among the prophets whose prophethood Allah wanted them to accept through a covenant was Muhammad ibn ‘Abd Allah, recipient of divine supreme covenant. Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious, then said to Adam, “Look (to find) what you can see.” ‘

The Imam then said, “Adam then looked and saw his descendents appearing as small particles that filled the sky. Adam then said, ‘Lord, how huge in number my descendents are! For what purpose have You created them and for what reason did You make them to establish a covenant with You?’” Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious, replied, “So that they worship Me and do not consider anything else as My equal and so that they believe in My messengers and follow them (for guidance).”

Adam then asked, “Lord, why is it that I see certain ones of the particles are greater, others have a great deal of lights, yet others among them have very little light and still others among them have no lights at all?” Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious, replied, “Thus, I have created them to place them to test in every condition that they will live.” Adam then asked, “My Lord, will You grant me permission to speak so I may express myself?” Allah, the Majestic the Glorious said, “Speak up; your spirit is from My spirit but your nature is different from My being.” Adam then asked, “Lord, had You created them all just like each other, by the same measure, the same nature, of likewise design, of the same color, of equal life span, of equal amount of means of living they would not act against each other. No jealousy, animosity and differences would exist among them over anything.”

Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious, said, “O Adam, through My spirit you just spoke and due to the weakness of your nature you made an effort to give an opinion about that of which you have no knowledge. I Am the Creator of the world. I knowingly have created each one different from the others and through My Own way I will make My commands to take effect and they will continue existing through My plans and measures. There will be no changes in My creation. I have created the Jinn and human beings only to worship Me. I have created paradise for those who obey and worship Me and follow My messengers. I have no regrets in what 1 have done. I have created the fire for those who disbelieve, disobey Me and do not follow My messengers and I have no regrets in it. I have created you and your descendents not because I ever need you or your descendents in anyway or form. I have created you and created them to test you and test them to see which ones among you do good deeds in the worldly life before your deaths. For this reason I have created the world and the life thereafter, life, death, obedience, disobedience, paradise and the fire.

This is how I willed in My measure and plan. Through My all-pervasive knowledge in them I have placed differences in their forms, bodies, colors, lifespan, means of living, obedience and disobedience. I, thus, have made certain ones of them to be unfortunate or very fortunate. Certain ones among them will have eyesight or be blind, others among them will be of short size or tall ones, beautiful or otherwise, knowledgeable or ignorant, wealthy or poor, obedient or disobedient, of good health or suffering from illness, of defective bodies or free of bodily defects. In this way those of perfect bodies will look at the defective ones and thank Me for the perfect body that 1 have given them and those with defective bodies will look at the perfect ones and will pray to Me and ask Me to grant them good health and exercise patience when and in the way I test them. Thus, I will grant them good rewards. The wealthy ones after looking to the poor ones will thank Me and appreciate My favors. When the poor ones look to the wealthy ones they pray to Me and ask Me favors. It is as such so that the believers will look to the unbelievers and thank Me for the guidance that I have granted them.

For such reasons I have created them. I test them in ease and in hardships and in good health that I grant them and in the matters with which I test them, in the matters of what I grant them and in the matters that 1 refuse them. I am Allah, the powerful King. It is all up to Me to allow all of My measures and plans to take form or change them as I wish to the time that I wish. I may change the sequel of the timing of my measures and plans and allow, that which comes first to come last and vice versa. I am Allah, and I execute whatever I will. I am not questioned for whatever I do but 1 question My creatures about their deeds.’””
